name: Pro Treadmill X9000
description: Commercial-grade treadmill with a 22-inch HD touchscreen, speeds up to 15 mph, incline range of -3% to 15%, and Bluetooth connectivity. Built-in heart rate monitoring and over 40 preset workout programs.

name: Elite Spin Bike
description: Premium indoor cycling bike with a 23.8-inch rotating touchscreen, magnetic resistance, and integrated speaker system. Includes free 30-day trial of streaming classes.

name: StairMaster Gauntlet
description: Revolving staircase design provides the ultimate cardio workout. Features 10-inch touchscreen console, 10 workout programs, and heart rate monitoring via contact grips and wireless chest strap.

name: Power Rack Pro
description: Heavy-duty power rack with 3x3 inch 11-gauge steel uprights, Westside hole spacing, and 1,000 lb capacity. Includes J-cups, safety pins, and band pegs. Compatible with all standard Rogue attachments.

name: Adjustable Bench FID
description: Commercial flat/incline/decline bench with 7 back pad positions and 3 seat positions. 1,000 lb rated capacity, grippy pad, and wheels for easy transport.

name: Olympic Barbell Set
description: 20 kg Olympic barbell with 190,000 PSI tensile strength steel, needle bearings, and composite bushings. Includes 300 lbs of calibrated bumper plates.

name: Dumbbell Set 5-50 lb
description: SelectTech adjustable dumbbells replace 15 sets of weights. Quick dial adjustment from 5 to 52.5 lbs in 2.5 lb increments. Includes compact storage stand.

name: Kettlebell Set
description: Set of 6 powder-coated cast iron kettlebells (8kg, 12kg, 16kg, 20kg, 24kg, 32kg) with flat bases and color-coded handles per competition standard.

name: Lat Pulldown / Low Row
description: Dual-function lat pulldown and low row machine with 250 lb weight stack, dual overhead pulleys, and adjustable thigh hold-down. Smooth cam action for consistent resistance.

name: Cable Crossover Machine
description: Dual adjustable cable columns with 200 lb weight stacks each, 19 pulley positions per column, and integrated chin-up bar. Ideal for isolation and functional exercises.

name: Smith Machine All-in-One
description: All-in-one Smith machine with functional trainer, power rack, and leg press. Counter-balanced Smith bar, dual 200 lb weight stacks, and over 40 exercise stations.

name: Battle Ropes 50ft
description: 50-foot heavy battle rope made from poly dacron with heat-shrink grip ends. 1.5-inch diameter, ideal for HIIT training and metabolic conditioning. Requires open floor area.

name: Pull-Up / Dip Station
description: Heavy-duty pull-up and dip station with multi-grip pull-up bar, vertical knee raise pads, and dip handles. 400 lb weight capacity, powder-coated steel.

name: Plyo Box Set
description: Set of 3 foam plyo boxes (20, 24, and 30 inches) with high-density foam core and vinyl cover. Stackable design with anti-slip bottom for plyometric training.

name: Stretching Mat XL
description: Extra-large professional stretching mat (6ft x 4ft) with 8mm dense cushioning. Closed-cell surface prevents sweat absorption. Non-toxic, emissions-free PVC.

name: Foam Roller Station
description: Wall-mounted foam roller storage station with 4 high-density foam rollers of varying densities. Includes massage balls and stretching strap set.

name: Dumbbell Rack 3-Tier
description: Heavy-duty 3-tier dumbbell rack holding up to 15 pairs. Welded steel construction with rubber-coated saddles to protect dumbbells and reduce noise.

name: Plate Storage Tree
description: Vertical weight plate storage tree with 8 posts accommodating Olympic plates. Small footprint, powder-coated finish, and rubberized base to protect floors.

name: Rowing Machine
description: The gold standard of rowing machines with air resistance flywheel, PM5 performance monitor, and nickel-plated chain. Separates in two for easy storage.

name: Rubber Gym Flooring
description: Interlocking rubber gym floor tiles, 3/4-inch thick, sold in packs of 6 (covers 24 sq ft). High-density recycled rubber with shock absorption and noise reduction.
